## 9. Serialized fingerprint evidence

The canonical representation of `ResolutionFingerprint` was serialized to JSON,
read back and hashed again.

Observed invariant:

```text
stable_digest(original fingerprint)
==
stable_digest(canonical JSON round-trip)
==
ResolutionFingerprint.cache_identity
```

The cache entries themselves remain process-local and are deliberately not persisted.

## 10. Performance measurements

Actual runtime measurements were collected for 0, 1, 2, 4 and 8 color effects.

| Effects | Cold median | Warm median | Misses | Hits |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0 | 201,114 ns | 116,476 ns | 1 | 200 |
| 1 | 327,765 ns | 125,920 ns | 1 | 200 |
| 2 | 522,800 ns | 130,802 ns | 1 | 200 |
| 4 | 649,092 ns | 140,648 ns | 1 | 200 |
| 8 | 1,115,587 ns | 169,270 ns | 1 | 200 |

These are local engineering measurements, not production hardware certification.
The warm path still computes the complete fingerprint; the measurements therefore
include the actual cache-key validation cost.

## 11. Visual QA

The board was generated from actual `resolve_component()` calls. It compares:

```text
uncached result  ↔  cache-miss result  ↔  cache-hit result
```

Cases:

- 0 effect / neutral;
- very dark shadow;
- mid-tone tint;
- high-light tint;
- complementary sequence;
- partial-alpha / close colors.

The board was visually inspected after generation. The swatches remain visually
identical between uncached and cached paths, while the complementary sequence still
shows the established existing effect result rather than a cache-induced change.

Artifact:

`artifacts/v139_resolution_cache_closure/V1.39_RESOLUTION_CACHE_RUNTIME_BOARD.png`

SHA-256:

```text
583f7383f5964b0dc8fb7b8c565dcb20f4dd9275325c04e1c08e22fd5d9917d4
```

## 12. Color-operation audit

No new COLOR operation was discovered.

The cache does not perform color calculations. The only existing RGB operation
remains:

```text
runtime/effect_color.py
    effect.color.srgb8-interpolation
```

No HSL, OKLab, XYZ, gamut mapping, alpha compositing, lighting, shading, material
response or grading operation was added.

## 13. Tests

Fresh V1.39 focused suite:

```text
20 passed
0 failed
```

Relevant existing effect/state/relation/consequence/version regressions were also
executed successfully.

The complete repository contains **891 collected tests** across **104 test files**.
All 104 files were executed in deterministic batches:

```text
890 passed
1 skipped
0 failed
```

The skip remains the pre-existing PostgreSQL integration test requiring
`VISUAL_ENGINE_POSTGRES_DSN`.

A monolithic `pytest -q` run was also attempted with a 900-second window. It reached
96% before timeout, so **no monolithic PASS is claimed**. The 891-test result above is
composite batch evidence covering all collected test files.

`python -m compileall -q src tests tools` passed after the implementation.
